items.q: Did you contact the police for me?
items.a: No. This app never contacts police, FIA, NCCIA, or Cyber Hayat staff by itself.

items.q: Should I send money to stop a leak?
items.a: Do not send more money or images. Preserve the demand as evidence and seek help through official routes when you can.
